name: 12-done-timestamped
why: Regression guard for the r6 item 1 bug: in the normal workflow the guard is pointed at the file written by run-timestamped.ps1, whose every line starts with a host-side HH:mm:ss.fff timestamp. This fixture is the verbatim final status block of the real archive 04c-follow-class-green-timed.txt (LF endings kept). Before the fix, the line-anchored INSTRUMENTATION_CODE regex never matched it, the tail was misread as RUNNING, and the guard stayed in its wait loop. Fixed behaviour: DONE / exit 0.
